roadmap.bestCombination: Pearson cash-ins use the candidate's best valid unit combination across attempts. Selection-mode calculators (YFM01) apply the board's Rule 1 over the entered units — best qualification grade first, then best UMS total. Pair-mode courses (YMA01 suite) still grade the marks the user enters for the chosen pair, one mark per unit slot.
